title: Metro station
checked: Every reachable state checked (14 states, 16 steps). All 5 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 5 states is reached from the start, and every path can still reach its end (aboard).

rules.rule: Nobody reaches the platform without paying
rules.says: Past the gates (paid side, platform, train) the traveller always has a ticket or a card.
rules.path: Take away the has a ticket guard and it breaks in 2 steps: down the escalator or lift, jump the gates.

rules.rule: Nobody steps off the platform edge
rules.says: The traveller is only ever on board when a train is in with its doors open.
rules.path: Take away the doors open guard and it breaks in 5 steps: down the escalator or lift, buy a ticket, through the gates [has a ticket], down the escalator or stairs, step towards an empty track.

rules.rule: One train at the platform at a time
rules.says: A second train never pulls in on top of the first.
rules.path: Take away the no train in guard and it breaks in 5 steps: down the escalator or lift, buy a ticket, through the gates [has a ticket], down the escalator or stairs, a second train pulls in.

rules.rule: One bus at the stop at a time
rules.says: A second bus never pulls in while one is at the stop.
rules.path: Take away the stop empty guard and it breaks in 1 step: a second bus pulls in.
